title: Rocket Screen
openingSummary: POWR>TENT>PROC; produce E1 scouts then a sustained E3 screen; add walls and anti-infantry cover.
when: Enemy armor or aircraft is known and terrain can deny direct crush paths.
avoidWhen: Flame, Tesla, dog, or vehicle-crush access is open around the intended line.
opening: POWR > TENT > PROC with 3 E1 scouts out first
Nonstop E3 from the first TENT; second TENT when the bank supports it
GUN + BRIK lanes at the front to deny crush paths
composition: 14-18 E3 as the AT+AA core — every rocket soldier is a SAM that walks
4-6 E1 in front to absorb anti-infantry fire; 2 MEDI healing the mass
2 PBOX each garrisoned with an E3 (the bunker fires the rockets)
execution: queueMission sweep with the E1 screen only — never scout with E3s
guard E3 groups onto the GUN line and harvesters as a walking AA net
queueMission strike posture=assault targetPriority=production, hugging walls and cliffs — crush is the only cheap answer and terrain denies it
queueMission pincer with two wings so a crush dive eats only one
reinforce both wings continuously from both TENTs
On enemyRetreating do NOT pursue (E3s are slow) — strike their economy instead

phases.name: screen
phases.objective: Form a spread rocket screen behind walls, terrain, or anti-infantry defenses.

phases.name: pressure
phases.objective: Advance only with a screen and split legs so a single crush route cannot erase the force.

abortTransitions.when: Two groups are lost to crush, flame, or Tesla damage, or the enemy has no armor or air to counter.

claims.statement: The E3 carries anti-armor and anti-air weapons and costs 300 credits.
E3 remains infantry and can be crushed by compatible vehicle locomotors.
Terrain and walls improve E3 value by denying the direct movement needed to crush the screen.
Mix cheap rifle scouts into the opening rather than exposing the rocket core to first contact.
Transition to mobile armor or siege when the opponent stops presenting armor and air targets.
